title: House and Winter
author: Sable Almeida
blurb: Petra Winterbourne, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the harvest moon rises.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
